slides.title: THE FORMULAS
slides.note: Circumference is a length around the edge. Area is the space inside, so it has squared units.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: A circle has radius 5. Find C and A.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: A circle has diameter 12. Find its area.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: A = π(12)² when the diameter is 12
points: Always halve the diameter to get the radius first.
Square only the r, not the π: πr², not (πr)².

pageTitle: Area and Circumference of a Circle: Formulas and Examples
description: Learn the circle area and circumference formulas with two worked examples and the most common mistakes.
